content:
±16min long tape-sampler module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) made to record/overdub multiple takes (one after another) to compose songs, includes SuperCompress (reaction = 100ms) to secure audio from clipping and an export function to record/save content to /media/cassette.wav.

#1 copy cassette_1-7.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install cassette_1-7..."

controls :

aux : start/stop playing (green LED) and/or stop exporting

C1 key : reset position to the cue point (white LED flash)
C#1 key : start/stop recording new or overdubbing if playing (red LED blinking)

notes (from D1 to A#2) : playback pitch

B2 key : export/record to /media/orac/cassette.wav in realtime (blue LED) starting from the cue point, creates/overwrites the file each time, stop manually using the same key or aux

knob1 : force (affects playback start/stop and pitch reaction)
knob2 : precise playback pitch
knob3 : cue point / playhead position
knob4 : precise cue point / playhead position

v1.8 : compatibility with the Transport module : starts in sync, can be armed from the Transport module to record at start (but unfortunatly it's not in sync when overdubbing, i don't understand yet why the playback speed cannot be the same as recorded, but it's still useful to record one rythmic take then add synths, or else... for now)

v1.7 now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/sampler , now exporting to /media/orac/cassette.wav

v1.6 : stereo and overdub bugfixes

v1.5 : cassette is now 1000sec. long (16/17min. at normal speed), takes 336mo of RAM

v1.4 : should now receive MIDI start/stop (but i can't test it), minor graphic improvement, patch cleaned a little bit

v1.3 : new real-time export function with a dedicated key on B2 (blue LED) starting from the cue point (stop manually), the LED now flashes white when pressing the cue key (C1), other minor improvements

v1.2 : different key mapping (new dedicated record key on C#1), LED now blinks when recording, bugfix when reaching the end of the cassette
